slides.headline: This week in India's growth story.
7 stories, one week.
listItems: A nation isn't built by the decisions made in its capital. It's built by the ones made at your desk, today.
India just posted its biggest defence export year ever.
Someone taught you the first thing you ever got good at. Someone will teach the person who builds India's next big thing.
Born on September 5th: the philosopher who became a president, then gave his birthday away.
Every law that finally caught up with justice took someone willing to be first in line for it.
On September 6th, India's Supreme Court decided that equal citizenship isn't conditional.
In 2014, India couldn't manufacture a single solar cell. Today, it makes more solar panels than almost anywhere else on Earth.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: Every week adds another piece.
slides.body: None of these stories are the whole picture on their own — the picture is what they add up to, one week at a time, for the next 20 years.
